text: Naafiqiiɓe ɓen, worɓe e rewɓe maɓɓe, ko hawtuɓe fiyaaku naafiqiyaagal. Ko ɓe lunndiiɓe gomɗimɓe ɓen. Hiɓe yamira ŋiñere, ɓe haɗa moƴƴere, ɓe wuddira jawle maɓɓe ɗen ɓe saloo wintagol(nafku-gol) e fii laawol Alla. Ɓe yejjitirii Alla nde ɓe ɗoftotoo Mo, Alla kadi tertori ɓe ronkude fewnude ɓe. Pellet, naafiqiiɓe ɓen, ko kamɓe woni yaltuɓe e ɗoftaare Alla nden e laawol goonga ngol, ɓe wona e yeddugol Mo faloo laawol majjere.
